description: Create an asynchronous orbit turnaround from a project image or a public HTTPS image. Costs credits without get_cost: quote the price first and wait for the person's confirmation, then pass max_credits. Never automatically retry a paid run. Pass job_id to poll the existing run; it takes precedence over starting and needs no project or image. The selected views are approximate angle estimates, unvalidated on AI characters.

get_cost.description: Return the catalog price and current balance without starting or charging anything.

job_id.description: Existing orbit job id as a positive integer string; polls status and approximate views.

max_credits.description: Maximum credits confirmed by the person, as a nonnegative integer string; required to start.

project_id.description: Project id as a positive integer string; required to start.

startbild.description: Address of an image owned by this project or a public HTTPS image; required to start.

name: lab_orbit
title: Orbit Turnaround
